reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 4 recyclers trading the same material (10% of its feedstock)
60% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month
84% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.83x the cost floor)
Registered at an address shared with 1 other entity(ies)
Company was only 134 days old when it registered under EPR
26% of all certificates were generated in a single month

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Check the company's incorporation and registration history and the source of its capital.
